summary: XP Inc. filed a Form 6-K supplementing its 2026 Annual Meeting proxy statement to remove the re-election proposal for director Oscar Rodriguez Herrero, who voluntarily withdrew his candidacy and will resign as of May 29, 2026, due to no disagreement with the company. The board appointed Melissa Werneck to the Audit Committee (subject to her re-election) and José Luiz Majolo as an interim independent director effective May 29, 2026, until the 2027 AGM. A routine director resignation and board refreshment; no activist campaign, acquisition, or strategic review involved. Watch for any further board changes at the AGM.
